thread:
maria_alloc: FYI seeing allocation failures and 503s for several Dedicated customers in eu-west-2 since ~08:10 UTC. placement errors: 'no compatible device' and a bunch of throttles.
kevin_oncall: I'm on it. Any signs of noisy-tenant evictions or sudden host drain? :eyes:
sara_support: Customer reported timeouts and an auth flurry for heavy embedding jobs. They escalated with a screenshot of repeated 429/503. Ticket #INC-4521.
maria_alloc: Logs show autoscaler dropping new allocs because available_count went to 0 in the region while reserved pools still show capacity in other AZs. Suspect cross-AZ placement policy mismatch + a handful of hosts in maintenance.
jason_reliability: Ops-bot reports a rolling firmware patch on GPU hosts in eu-west-2 that started at 08:05 and marked nodes DRAINING. Looks correlated.
ops-bot: incident: host-drain-start eu-west-2: 8 hosts entering DRAINING state at 2026-03-17T08:05:13Z
kevin_oncall: That would explain sudden stockout. Are we failing over to eu-west-1 or eu-central? Our routing policy should route to fallback with canary for Dedicated but it may be blocked by region affinity for pinned customers.
sara_support: Several affected customers are on Dedicated reserved pools pinned to eu-west-2. They can't failover automatically. Customer-facing triage done; we've offered a manual soft-fallback but need infra signoff.
maria_alloc: Repro steps I used:
```\n# reproduce locally against allocator\ncurl -X POST https://allocator.internal/reverse-alloc \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -d '{"region":"eu-west-2","gpu_type":"a100-80gb","seq_len":2048}'\n# observe: response: 503 {"error":"no_compatible_device"}\n```
maria_alloc: Also saw allocator logs: `placement.go:312 allocate: available=0 reserved_available=2 draining=8`
jason_reliability: ETA on hosts coming back? Cloud partner says patch completes in ~25m but some hosts may auto-evict pods during drain which causes slow rebuild.
kevin_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) Stop new onboarding to pinned pools for affected customers (prevent additional allocation churn). 2) Enable burst-borrow from regional shared pool for critical customers (manual override). 3) Temporary relax region-affinity for non-compliance customers. Who can run the borrow?
maria_alloc: I can submit the manual override for two customers (they're high-sev). Will need approval to touch reserved pool config.
sara_support: I'll get approvals on the support side and notify customers targeted for manual borrow. Patch note to customers: expect degraded throughput for ~30-45m, possible reconnects.
jason_reliability: Dev note: autoscaler backoff currently uses a cooldown of 10m after repeated failures. With rolling drains we need to bump that logic to prefer cross-region fallback earlier. Filed FR: FR-ops-789.
kevin_oncall: For the postmortem please capture: why draining nodes caused allocator.available_count to drop to 0 while reserved_available remained >0 (looks like tag mismatch between host labels and reserved pool selector), and why routing refused fallback for pinned pools.
maria_alloc: Quick root cause hypothesis: host label mismatch + patch-induced drain causing non-uniform AZ capacity leading scheduler to consider region unschedulable. Also a side-effect: billing auth service retried and hit rate-limiters causing 401s for a subset of calls (we saw 401 spike at 08:12).
ops-bot: action: created task TASK-987 to run tag-reconcile and validate pool selectors.
sara_support: Customer comms draft: "We're investigating a regional capacity impact in eu-west-2 affecting Dedicated customers. We're executing manual reassignments and expect resolution within 1 hour. We'll follow up with root cause and a mitigation plan." Approving? :thumbsup:
kevin_oncall: Approve. Also schedule a follow-up postmortem with infra, allocator, and product owners.
jason_reliability: Long-term fixes to consider: - tighten pool selector tests during deployment, - autoscaler policy: allow controlled cross-region soft-fallback for reserved pools when >X% of region hosts are DRAINING, - better customer telemetry when pinned pools are unavailable.
maria_alloc: I'll apply manual borrow now for two highest-sev customers and watch. Running command:
```
POST /admin/pools/borrow?from=shared-eu-west-2&to=customer-pool-12
response: 200 OK
```
maria_alloc: Borrow applied. Re-routed 4 allocations successfully. Monitoring latency and errors.
sara_support: Customer #C-998 confirms generation resumed but slower. They saw one auth retry but back online.
kevin_oncall: Keep monitoring for 30m. If more than 10% of allocated hosts remain DRAINING after patch window then escalate to cross-region manual rebalance.
maria_alloc: Noted. I'll also open a follow-up to audit autoscaler cooldown semantics.
ops-bot: update: host-drain-complete on 3/17 08:30:21Z for 5 hosts, 3 hosts still draining.
jason_reliability: Thanks everyone. We'll collect logs and pack into the postmortem. Short term: manual borrow + relax affinity for non-critical pools fixed the immediate customer impact.
kevin_oncall: Closing status: mitigation in place, customer comms sent, postmortem scheduled. :fire_engine:
